notes.title: More fixes to the demo!

[/p][p][/p][p]Here you can find all the last fixes in detail:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]adjustment and various fixes in the Arena mode (now the “Naiade” will attack you);[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]the fight with the "Coccatrice di Pietra" has been made more intuitive;[/p][/*][*][p]Furcifel keeps getting stronger with every update;[/p][/*][*][p]the bug, which was making the whole interface stop working while scrolling the key bindings menu, has been fixed;[/p][/*][*][p]we fixed the bug that was making the horse drill too powerful;[/p][/*][*][p]the lock system has been made more responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We invite you to leave a review on the demo page to keep providing us with useful feedback so we can improve Stonemachia one step at the time![/p]

notes.title: A NEW SUPER STONEMACHIA DEMO UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[p]It is with excitement that we announce the newest version of Stonemachia's demo, refined and enriched thanks to all your support and feedback during this incredible year and a half![/p][p]With this new ‘update’, you'll be able to re-live the first moments of Stonemachia like it's the first time, thanks to a completely revamped tutorial level, an even more dynamic combat system, new mechanics, and much more![/p][p]

[/p][p]And now a deep dive into all the new features of the new Stonemachia demo![/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Overhaul maps and content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Sacrigera Fortress tutorial map has been completely revamped with a new progression, new enemies and new secrets![/p][/*][*][p]The Arena is enriched with new enemies and a new special reward that will let you further explore Medhelan and what Stonemachia has in store![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Combat System Overhaul:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Introducing the new [b][i]Gambetto System[/i][/b], a completely new game mechanic that will allow you to unleash the hidden power of the Angelic Armour and use a range of powerful special attacks that can [b][i]both damage the protagonist and activate unique abilities if parried in time[/i][/b]! (yes, now you can also parry yourself)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Complete Overhaul of the Horse.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Now the Horse is able to pierce enemies, throw its horn and, by using its Gambetto skill, make crosses fall from the sky![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]General balance overhaul of all four chess pieces.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Completely re-designed healing system.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Now healing no longer involves multiple vials but a single item that can be recharged by parrying and defeating enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]HUD and menus:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We added the option of re-mapping keys for both gamepad and keyboard. This functionality is still a bit broken but we will polish it up in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped dialogue interface and revised the interaction system in general.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][p][b]To access the new content, select ‘New Game’ from the main menu after downloading the update![/b][/p][p]
Let us know how your experience went by leaving a review on the [b]new demo page[/b] and join us on our Discord server if you would like to [b]test the game in advance[/b] or leave us your feedback![/p]

notes.title: STONEMACHIA BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
It has already been a month since the last demo and we realised that setting the map so openly might give a misleading representation of what Stonemachia really is.
For this reason, our FOURTH demo introduces the first two real maps of the game: the tutorial map and a part of Medhelan.

In detail this demo will feature:
- the first two maps of the complete game (like a proper demo), which will give an overview about the first hours of gameplay.
- new tutorial is set in the Castello Scaligero, which will feature new enemies, quests and bosses!
- overall game balancing.
- general optimisation.
- the return of the arena mode!

As always, we encourage you to share your feedback on our Discord server in the dedicated demo section!

notes.title: Optimization! Improved Tutorial and Progression! New Enemies!
notes.notes:
During the Next Fest, we received a ton of feedback, and we did our best to improve a demo we weren't particularly fond of.

We've significantly enhanced the progression in the demo, making it smoother and more straightforward. Most importantly, we've undertaken a monumental optimization effort, reworking 50% of the building assets in just a few months, which has dramatically improved performance.

There's still plenty of work to do, but we're committed to making Stonemachia a real, fun game.

Here's a list of all the changes:

A brand-new tutorial
New enemies added
Overall experience balancing improved
General optimization
Lighting improved for both performance and aesthetics


Thank you all for your patience, and we hope you enjoy this new demo!

notes.title: Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A minor update for the Stonemachia Demo has just been released, fixing some of the most common bugs, including:

- When reaching the bottom of the armored boar arena, the map was partially removed.
- The boss Mikaim's entrance only worked in the Italian language.
- The boss Mikaim spammed too many projectile attacks, and some animations were excessively fast.
- The stone griffin would get stuck in certain areas of its arena.
- Improved audio feedback for hits.
- Frame rate capped at 60 fps to prevent crashes and excessive CPU stress.
- The game can now be completed without collecting the angelic sword and shield; the base sword is permanent until a more powerful weapon is found.
- The lock-on reticle has been reduced in size.

notes.title: Stonemachia - Knights of the Opera
notes.notes:
In [b]Stonemachia Knights of the Oper[/b]a, you must reach the Theater of Medhelan and record your most spectacular combos to win a front-row seat of honor in the in-game theater.

[b]How to participate:
[/b]- Download the Stonemachia demo on Steam or update it
- Start the 'Theater' mode from the menu or explore to find it
- Record your performance and your best combos (you can use software like OBS, free cam, WINDOWS+ALT+R, Nvidia/AMD Recorder, or your phone)
- Share your video on any social media platform and in any way you prefer, specifying your nickname.
- Tag us or send it to us!
The top five performances will be rewarded live on Twitch (judged by the team)
[b]The prize is a front row seat in the theater (in-game)
The event will end in 1/2 weeks depending on how many videos we receive![/b]

[b]How are performances evaluated?[/b]
The focus of this event is on spectacular and creative use of moves. Performances will be judged based on their ability to utilize interconnected abilities between different pieces. You can opt to use a single piece, but be aware that the difficulty level increases as it's harder to create visually stunning combos. If you choose this route, your performance will be evaluated on your mastery and skillful use of that single piece!

Have fun!
